paragraphs.source_en: ‘Oh, a little further—only a little further, Ellen,’ was her answer, continually. ‘Climb to that hillock, pass that bank, and by the time you reach the other side I shall have raised the birds.’

units.source_en: ‘Oh, a little further—only a little further, Ellen,’ was her answer, continually.
‘Climb to that hillock, pass that bank, and by the time you reach the other side I shall have raised the birds.’

paragraphs.source_en: But there were so many hillocks and banks to climb and pass, that, at length, I began to weary, and told her we must halt, and retrace our steps. I shouted to her, as she had out stripped me a long way; she either did not hear or did not regard, for she still sprang on, and I was compelled to follow. Finally, she dived into a hollow; and before I came in sight of her again, she was two miles nearer Wuthering Heights than her own home; and I beheld a couple of persons arrest her, one of whom I felt convinced was Mr. Heathcliff himself.
